visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens with a close-up shot of pink-themed Mickey and Minnie Mouse plush toys sitting on a light-colored wooden shelf. They are dressed in traditional Japanese kimonos with soft pink hues. The characters have pink eyes and stitched smiles, and their feet are embroidered with a white 'Disney store JAPAN' logo. (2) A white promotional sign is placed on the shelf, featuring black text that indicates these items are 'Exclusive to limited stores'. The background shows other merchandise in a well-lit retail environment. (3) The camera shifts to a larger display featuring 'Chip & Dale' plush toys. These characters are wearing pastel-colored unicorn hoodies with a small horn on top. A person's hand reaches in to point at a small blue-hooded plush sitting on the middle shelf. (4) A hand holds up two rabbit plushies, Thumper and Miss Bunny, displaying their soft gray and tan fur. In the foreground, the unicorn-hooded Chip and Dale figures remain visible, creating a layered product presentation. They rotate their hand to show the padded white underside and the detailed cat face on top. Nearby, various gray cat kitchen gadgets are hung on a retail display grid. (9) The camera focuses on two pens featuring cat paw tops—one gray and one pink striped. The hand holding them clicks the pink pen's mechanism, causing a small cat head to pop out from the top. (10) A shiny blue foil package for 'LuLuLun Precious Balance' face masks is shown, featuring golden Disney-themed constellations and patterns. (11) The video concludes with a static pink graphic end-screen displaying social media icons and the 'Japanuts' website URL.
